trust_decision.summary: Whether a request-supplied theme file path (fullpath / path / base_name, raw or URL-encoded) stays inside the theme (or source theme/plugin type) directory; decided by getFullpath() for the API, by nothing in admin-web parseArgs(), and by assertWithinThemeDir() at the write/copy sinks, which checks the raw string against the whole App::path('plugins') root while ThemeFileForm and copy() rawurldecode the path afterwards.

landing_point.why: Summary says 'encoded path traversal in the theme file API'; the API edit action (plugins/bc-theme-file/src/Controller/Api/Admin/ThemeFilesController.php:75-81) goes to update(), whose assertWithinThemeDir check runs on the raw value while ThemeFileForm::_execute decodes it later.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The report is about the API and encoded '..'; the admin-web controller is a different transport, its read-only img/view actions 'only display' files, and copy_to_theme legitimately reads core/plugin files outside the current theme, so a solver can argue the source side is meant to be unrestricted.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Admin users must still view core/plugin templates and assets (BaserCore, BcFront, plugin templates) and copy them into the current theme via copy_to_theme / copy_folder_to_theme; edits to other installed themes and to not-yet-existing paths (new files/folders) must work. A fix that limits reads to the current theme or requires realpath() to exist breaks these.

O6_input_shapes: URL-encoded %2e%2e%2f that is decoded after the check (ThemeFileForm update, ThemeFilesService::copy)
double-encoded %252e in base_name (decoded once by update, once more by check)
traversal in URL passed-args segments for admin web (decoded by parseArgs rawurldecode)
path landing inside plugins/ but outside any theme (core plugin dir) or in another theme
prefix-sibling directory (img_evil vs img) handled by trailing-DS compare

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Admin web theme_files/index has no template-type allow-list, and parseArgs takes type from a URL segment; the fixed parseArgs check uses viewPath.type as its own base, so a traversal in type moves the base and the folder listing (ThemeFoldersService::getIndex) reads outside the theme.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Index is only a directory listing (names, not contents), and every other action already checks getTemplateTypeName, so it looks like a known-safe navigation page.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same controller as the admin parseArgs fix; sink in plugins/bc-theme-file/src/Service/ThemeFoldersService.php:107-120 (another file)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: assertWithinThemeDir without a theme argument (create/update/delete/upload/copy/folder ops/batch) still accepts any installed Theme or AdminTheme, so admin-web POST bodies can write into another theme (e.g. the default or admin theme) than the one in the URL.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Admins may edit any theme by design; only copyToTheme has a 'current theme' notion, so cross-theme writes look like a feature.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same service file as the landing point
